newsitem.title: USA: Genesis issues Q2, Q3 sales estimates.
newsitem.headline: Genesis issues Q2, Q3 sales estimates.

text.p: Genesis Insurance & Financial Services Inc said Tuesday that second quarter ended June 30, 1996 sales exceeded $5 million and third quarter sales will exceed $7 million.

The company said in a release Tuesday that second quarter sales results were derived primarily from the sale of Surety Products issued by Congress Re-Insurance Corp and American Lift Corp, both wholly owned subsidiaries.
Third quarter sales estimates include consolidated sales and revenue of all operating divisions, Genesis added.
